templates.label: Generate handoff summary
templates.text: Generate a concise handoff summary of the current implementation state: current phase, wave, task, what's done today, what's next, and any owner gates or blockers. Base it on tools/progress-dashboard/progress.json and activity.json.

templates.label: Generate implementation report
templates.text: Produce an implementation report for today's work: tasks completed, commits, tests, analyze results, and remaining items for the current phase. Use the dashboard JSON as the source of truth.
